paper.title: Quasi-oracle estimation of heterogeneous treatment effects

mechanism.name: 正态特征与常数效应的非线性混杂
mechanism.title_en: Confounded constant effect with softplus baseline

sampling.dependence: Three active covariates, nonlinear softplus baseline and logistic propensity. No explicit product term is tagged as an interaction. Propensity is pointwise positive but not uniformly bounded away from 0/1 on Gaussian support. Independent treatment/noise random draws conditional on covariates; no clusters or panel structure.

assumptions: Consistency and no interference across independent individuals.
Conditional exchangeability given observed baseline X under the declared synthetic assignment.
Pointwise positivity; no uniform overlap bound claimed for unbounded Gaussian logistic settings.

properties.notes: Three active covariates, nonlinear softplus baseline and logistic propensity. No explicit product term is tagged as an interaction. Propensity is pointwise positive but not uniformly bounded away from 0/1 on Gaussian support.

estimand.name: ATE
estimand.definition: E[Y(1)-Y(0)] in the full declared covariate population; treatment 1 versus 0; population, not sample-conditional, target.

truth.expression: E[Y(1)-Y(0)] in the full declared covariate population; treatment 1 versus 0; population, not sample-conditional, target.
truth.derivation: The difference of conditional means is tau(X)=1 for every X, so ATE=1 under the full covariate population.

adaptations: Target explicitly changed from conditional effect tau(x) to population ATE E[tau(X)]; original data-generating law retained. No claim that the source reports this ATE numerical value.
Source treatment indicator is named A in the observed output; no scientific change.
Independently implemented Python/NumPy sampler; source estimator fitting and large simulation replications are outside this collection task.
